prs.rationale: Renaming a user field across 12 files including schema, session, admin pages, actions, and documentation represents a meaningful cross-cutting refactor with non-trivial coordination effort.

prs.rationale: Adding prod/staging AppRunner configs with updated secrets across 4 files and 188 lines is a solid infrastructure setup task, slightly more involved than a simple config tweak.

prs.author: Jason
prs.rationale: A leads upload fix with a reworked API route and CSV upload dialog (the core functional changes) plus substantial documentation/TODO notes across 5 files totaling 759 lines — functional work is medium-sized but well-documented.

prs.rationale: Adding verbose debug logging to a single assessor file is a small, temporary diagnostic change with 93 lines of log statements.

prs.title: create company with no users
prs.author: Chris

prs.title: saves BTS as company field value
prs.author: Chris
prs.rationale: Only 30 lines of custom work (flagged as 82% vendored) saving BTS as a company field value across 3 files is a small targeted feature addition.

prs.title: introduces automatic aws microsite generation
prs.author: Chris
prs.rationale: Introducing automatic AWS microsite generation is a significant new feature spanning a full API pipeline (prompt, route, stream), UI components, gap actions, and docker config across 9 files and 908 lines.

prs.title: fixes slide styles

prs.rationale: A 5-line single-file slide style fix is a trivial UI tweak.

prs.title: sends lead csv as email

prs.title: view company s3 files
prs.author: Chris
prs.rationale: Builds out a significant admin feature spanning S3 file browsing, attachment management, server actions, and an S3 service layer across five files with nearly 800 lines of custom code, constituting a major new capability with multiple coordinated components.

stories.name: Staging Environment Migration to AppRunner
stories.rationale: Migrated the staging environment to AWS AppRunner by splitting prod/staging configurations and updating associated secrets, enabling isolated and reproducible deployment environments.

stories.name: AI Agent Core Build and Debugging
stories.rationale: Built the core AI agent feature and iterated on its reliability by adding then reverting verbose logging used to diagnose issues during development.

stories.name: Competitive Analysis AI Improvement
stories.rationale: Enhanced the AI-powered competitive analysis capability to produce higher quality and more actionable insights for businesses.

stories.name: Automated Microsite Generation
stories.rationale: Introduced automatic AWS-hosted microsite generation, enabling the platform to programmatically create and deploy customer-facing microsites.

stories.name: Company Role and User Type Management
stories.rationale: Added a company role concept and standardized the user role field to 'type' across the codebase, strengthening the platform's access and identity model.

stories.name: Lead Upload and CSV Email Delivery
stories.rationale: Fixed the leads CSV upload flow and added the ability to send lead CSVs via email, improving the end-to-end lead management and sharing experience.

stories.name: Company Admin Tools: Creation and File Viewing
stories.rationale: Enabled admins to create companies without requiring existing users and to view associated S3 files, expanding internal tooling for company lifecycle management.

stories.name: Save Business Target Segment as Company Field
stories.rationale: Persisted the Business Target Segment (BTS) as a company-level field value, ensuring key segmentation data is stored against the company record.

stories.name: Presentation Slide Style Fix
stories.rationale: Fixed styling issues in slide components to improve the visual presentation experience for end users.
